run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to relax an adslab system and compute adsorption energy using an ASE calculator
compute_hybrid_adsorption_energy: compute hybrid adsorption energy by combining ML-relaxed adslab energies with DFT slab reference energies
relax_adslab_with_surface: relax an adsorbate-slab system with surface relaxation enabled to compute full ML adsorption energy
save_relaxed_adslab_atoms: run adsorb_atoms with save_relaxed_atoms enabled to encode and return relaxed atom configurations as JSON
compute_dft_adsorption_energy: compute DFT adsorption energy from pre-stored relaxed adslab and slab energies in the atoms info dictionary
